Respondents  PRAYER: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution of  India, to issue a writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents 2 and  4 to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 17.04.2019  and further to take action against the seventh respondent in  accordance with law. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.V.Rajiv Rufus  For RR 1 to 6 : Mr.M.Senthil Ayyanar  Government Advocate  For R  7 : Mr.M.Jegadeesh Pandian  ORDER This Writ Petition has been filed for a direction, directing the respondents 2 and 4 to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 17.04.2019 and to take action as against the seventh respondent in accordance with law. 
2.Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials placed before this Court. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the Writ Petition , the respondents 2 and 4 are directed to consider the representation submitted by the petitioner, dated 17.04.2019, after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the seventh respondent and pass appropriate orders, on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. 
Chinnadurai vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40575901/
2 4.With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs.
